comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Generic and specialty prescription drugs; different business from Merit's disposable interventional medical devices.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Injectable drugs, inhalers and diagnostic kits are pharmaceutical products, not procedural medical devices.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Rare-disease therapies sold as prescription drugs; no overlap with Merit's disposable device products.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Orthopedic bone-healing, pain and biologic products sold to surgeons; different products and clinical customers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Cardiovascular devices, including transcatheter products and monitoring, sold to hospital cath and cardiac labs like Merit's interventional lines.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Dental implants, aligners and orthodontic products sold to dental practices; different products and customers.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Disposable vascular access and IV consumables sold to hospitals, overlapping Merit's disposable device model, though it also sells drugs.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Opioid use disorder prescription medicines sold through pharmacies and clinics; a pharmaceutical business.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Neurosurgical instruments and implants for open surgery; shares hospital surgeons but not Merit's catheter and interventional products.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Radiopharmaceutical imaging agents and generators; used in radiology but a drug business, not disposable devices.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Noninvasive patient monitoring, sensors and consumer wearables; different products and software-based revenue.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Tissue-based chronic wound care products and skin substitutes; different products and clinical use.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Branded non-opioid injectable drugs and a nerve-pain device; pharmaceutical model differs from Merit.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Diversified across tapes, dental products, coding software and documentation services; not a focused device business.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Home-use pneumatic compression devices for lymphedema, reimbursed through rentals; different products and setting.

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Vascular access catheters, interventional catheters and guidewires sold to hospitals and physicians, closely matching Merit's core lines.

comps.label: C17
comps.reason: Spine implants and bone graft products used in spine surgery; different products and surgeon customers.
